GFN = max(0, principal_due_at_scenario_FX + interest - primary_surplus + other_cash_flows); compare committed financing plus explicit fiscal cash draw, not unused cash capacity
debt-stabilizing primary balance = interest + FX_revaluation + other_flows - fiscal_cash_draw - opening_debt*nominal_GDP_growth
reserve_import_months=12*reserves/imports_next_12_months; reserves/short_term_external_debt uses residual maturity, same whole-economy scope
